audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: Refuge, other gods, inheritance, counsel, joy, Sheol, and path of life.

verses.restored: Preserve me, O God: for in thee do I put my trust.

familiar.text: Preserve me, O God: for in thee do I put my trust.

modern.text: Preserve me, O God, for in You I take refuge.

original.text: מִכְתָּ֥ם לְדָוִ֑ד שָֽׁמְרֵ֥נִי אֵ֝֗ל כִּֽי חָסִ֥יתִי בָֽךְ

verses.restored: O my soul, thou hast said unto YHWH, Thou art my Lord: my goodness extendeth not to thee;

familiar.text: O my soul, thou hast said unto the LORD, Thou art my Lord: my goodness extendeth not to thee;

modern.text: I said to the LORD, “You are my Lord; apart from You I have no good thing.”

original.text: אָמַ֣רְתְּ לַֽ֭יהוָה אֲדֹנָ֣י אָ֑תָּה ט֝וֹבָתִ֗י בַּל עָלֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: But to the saints that are in the earth, and to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.

familiar.text: But to the saints that are in the earth, and to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.

modern.text: As for the saints in the land, they are the excellence in whom all my delight resides.

original.text: לִ֭קְדוֹשִׁים אֲשֶׁר בָּאָ֣רֶץ הֵ֑מָּה וְ֝אַדִּירֵ֗י כָּל חֶפְצִי בָֽם

verses.restored: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips.

familiar.text: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips.

modern.text: Sorrows will multiply to those who chase other gods. I will not pour out their libations of blood, or speak their names with my lips.

original.text: יִרְבּ֥וּ עַצְּבוֹתָם֮ אַחֵ֪ר מָ֫הָ֥רוּ בַּל אַסִּ֣יךְ נִסְכֵּיהֶ֣ם מִדָּ֑ם וּֽבַל אֶשָּׂ֥א אֶת שְׁ֝מוֹתָ֗ם עַל שְׂפָתָֽי

verses.restored: YHWH is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.

familiar.text: The LORD is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.

modern.text: The LORD is my chosen portion and my cup; You have made my lot secure.

original.text: יְֽהוָ֗ה מְנָת חֶלְקִ֥י וְכוֹסִ֑י אַ֝תָּ֗ה תּוֹמִ֥יךְ גּוֹרָלִֽי

verses.restored: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.

familiar.text: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.

modern.text: The lines of my boundary have fallen in pleasant places; surely my inheritance is delightful.

original.text: חֲבָלִ֣ים נָֽפְלוּ לִ֭י בַּנְּעִמִ֑ים אַף נַ֝חֲלָ֗ת שָֽׁפְרָ֥ה עָלָֽי

verses.restored: I will bless YHWH, who hath given me counsel: my innermost being also instruct me in the night seasons.

familiar.text: I will bless the LORD, who hath given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.

modern.text: I will bless the LORD who counsels me; even at night my conscience instructs me.

original.text: אֲבָרֵ֗ךְ אֶת יְ֭הוָה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְעָצָ֑נִי אַף לֵ֝יל֗וֹת יִסְּר֥וּנִי כִלְיוֹתָֽי

verses.restored: I have set YHWH always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

familiar.text: I have set the LORD always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

modern.text: I have set the LORD always before me. Because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.

original.text: שִׁוִּ֬יתִי יְהוָ֣ה לְנֶגְדִּ֣י תָמִ֑יד כִּ֥י מִֽ֝ימִינִ֗י בַּל אֶמּֽוֹט

verses.restored: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope.

familiar.text: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope.

modern.text: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will dwell securely.

original.text: לָכֵ֤ן שָׂמַ֣ח לִ֭בִּי וַיָּ֣גֶל כְּבוֹדִ֑י אַף בְּ֝שָׂרִ֗י יִשְׁכֹּ֥ן לָבֶֽטַח

verses.restored: For you will not abandon my being to Sheol, nor let your faithful one see the Pit [or corruption].

familiar.text: For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

notes.title: Sheol and shachat
notes.body: Sheol names the realm of the dead. The final noun may be read as “pit” or, in some reception traditions, “corruption/decay.” The verse should not be flattened into a later doctrinal reading without noting the Hebrew ambiguity.

modern.text: For You will not abandon my soul to Sheol, nor will You let Your Holy One see decay.

original.text: כִּ֤י לֹא תַעֲזֹ֣ב נַפְשִׁ֣י לִשְׁא֑וֹל לֹֽא תִתֵּ֥ן חֲ֝סִידְךָ֗ לִרְא֥וֹת שָֽׁחַת

verses.restored: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.

familiar.text: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.

modern.text: You have made known to me the path of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence, with eternal pleasures at Your right hand.

original.text: תּֽוֹדִיעֵנִי֮ אֹ֤רַח חַ֫יִּ֥ים שֹׂ֣בַע שְׂ֭מָחוֹת אֶת פָּנֶ֑יךָ נְעִמ֖וֹת בִּימִינְךָ֣ נֶֽצַח

translation_notes: This chapter expands corpus coverage while remaining explicitly pending a deeper Hebrew/source-witness audit. KJV is retained only as the familiar comparison layer.

The completion draft intentionally preserves coherent traditional English syntax where a verse has not yet received a curated Hebrew-sensitive rendering; it does not mix archaic and modern grammar. Major identified lexical/textual issues receive explicit overrides and notes.
safety_note: Afterlife language and “other gods” language should be translated historically and not used to persecute other religions or spiritual practices.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Scrolls where extant, and other relevant witnesses during the global audit.
Preserve Psalm numbering and superscription differences across Hebrew and Greek traditions rather than silently harmonizing them.
